$comment: Built-in AI Enhancement quality profiles (ADR-0009 layer 6). A profile only states WHAT may be processed and to which scale; the per-asset recipe (asset-recipe schema) and the locked models come from the AI track (Remaster-Toolkit). Modes: sr = deterministic super-resolution only; sr+refine = SR plus controlled generative refinement (RD-003). Categories not listed use defaultMode.

off.description: No AI processing; every asset keeps its selected source.

conservative.description: Deterministic SR x2 of opaque world textures; UI, fonts, technical maps and effects untouched.

standard.description: SR x4 with generative refinement for tileable world surfaces; SR x4 for characters and props; SR x2 for effects.
